On the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], a '''Veknoid''' wearing a [[Color/Legends|purple]] vest and purple shorts was addressed by a young [[Unidentified Amaran child|member]] of the [[Amaran/Legends|Amaran]] [[Species/Legends|species]] who was lying between the back legs of a creature known as a [[Bursa/Legends|bursa]].
